Regulatory change has outgrown the systems built to manage it. Most enterprises run their compliance programs on GRC foundations built decades ago, while regulators ship more changes, faster, across more domains than at any point in the last twenty years. Three forces are widening the governance gap. THE PACE OF CHANGE Regulatory output now exceeds what any compliance team can manually track. Regulatory change has outgrown the systems built to manage it. Most enterprises run their compliance programs on GRC foundations built decades ago, while regulators ship more changes, faster, across more domains than at any point in the last twenty years. Three forces are widening the governance gap. RULES IN MOTION Regulations don't just keep changing. They keep changing direction. Section 1071 was issued, unwound, and re-issued. Section 1033 ran three versions in parallel. The CFPB overdraft rule was finalized and then nullified. Rules no longer hold still long enough for compliance teams to retool. By the time a control is deployed, the underlying obligation has moved. NEW AI REGULATIONS New regulatory frontiers are arriving faster than oversight can be built. The EU Al Act activates high-risk enforcement August 2, 2026, with penalties up to €35 million or 7 percent of global turnover. Gartner ranks Al regulation a top research topic. The next frontier is opening before the last one closed. The choice is no longer whether AI runs inside the enterprise. It is which AI is defensible. WHAT IS ARCHER EVOLV™ From regulatory source to audit evidence, with lineage all the way through. Horizon scanning across authoritative regulatory sources, powered by compliance-trained AI Obligation extraction with calibrated confidence and full audit lineage Continuous control mapping, policy alignment, and assurance evidence Scenario analysis to model regulatory impact before a rule lands Archer Evolv connects regulatory change to obligations, controls, policies, and assurance evidence. Deploy standalone or as an extension of any existing Archer GRC installation. On-prem or SaaS. No migration required. THE ARCHER EVOLV PORTFOLIO Three connected solutions on one data foundation.
